# ignitify_deployment (Resource)

The deployed code of a task: the files of a task folder, uploaded and built by the server. A change of the files uploads them again and waits for the build. Once the new deployment is READY, the old one is deleted, which ends its running runs and deletes its run history; hooks belong to the task and are not changed. A failed build keeps the old deployment. An update needs one free deployment slot. Needs tasks.read, deployments.read and deployments.write; the notify fields also need hooks.write.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A change of the files in source_dir uploads them and waits for the build.
# The old deployment is deleted once the new one is READY.
resource "ignitify_deployment" "report" {
  task       = ignitify_task.report.slug
  source_dir = "${path.module}/report"

  timeouts = {
    create = "45m"
    update = "45m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_dir` (String) The task folder. The upload holds the files a deploy selects: no `.env` files, vendored dependencies or local state, and not the paths `.ignitifyignore` leaves out. Symlinks and registry credentials are refused.
- `task` (String) The slug of the task. It must equal the `slug` in the folder's task config. A change replaces the deployment. The import id.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `notify_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The key that signs each notify call (write-only, at least 32 characters). Terraform cannot see a change of it: change notify_secret_wo_version to send it again.
- `notify_secret_wo_version` (Number) Any number. A change sends notify_url and notify_secret_wo again.
- `notify_url` (String) A URL the deployment calls when a run ends. Unset clears it. Needs notify_secret_wo.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `content_hash` (String) The server's content key of the deployment.
- `deployment_id` (String) The server id of the live deployment. Unknown in a plan that uploads.
- `execution` (String) The `execution` block the task config declares, as JSON; null when it declares none.
- `secrets` (List of String) The secret names the task config declares; null when it declares none.
- `source_hash` (String) A digest of the selected files, computed at plan time. A change uploads the files again.
- `status` (String) The deployment status: READY after a successful apply. Any other status uploads again at the next apply.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The task slug imports a task with exactly one live deployment.
terraform import ignitify_deployment.report report

# Otherwise name the deployment: <task slug>/<deployment id>.
terraform import ignitify_deployment.report report/<deployment_id>
```
